title: Svar från Belgien angående oral format
summary: Quoted authority reply: the service provider must make both written and oral formats available. In the authority's interpretation of Article 13(2), mere compatibility with assistive technology is insufficient.

Top-level authority reply: an option to read the information aloud is sufficient. The provider may supply it through an app or video/audio recording; the method matters less than provision by the provider. The customer cannot be required to buy the app. The reply does not require a recording specifically or approve a named product/API implementation.
scope: Belgian Economic Inspection expertise: consumer banking and e-commerce. Attributed correspondence interpretation of Article 13(2)/Annex V, not a court ruling or a position of every Belgian authority.
limitations: Documentary source review, not independent sender authentication or publication approval.
No general endorsement of ReadSpeaker, Web Speech API or an implementation was established.
No separate webpage, mandatory recording, sanctions or EN edition adoption inferred.
User-authored questions about Sweden/Denmark are not Belgian authority findings.
public_candidate: Candidate for the Belgium service-information cell in EAA authorities and reporting by country.md: attribute to Economic Inspection (consumer banking/e-commerce) that assistive-technology compatibility alone is insufficient, while a provider-supplied read-aloud option can satisfy its oral-format interpretation without requiring the customer to purchase an app. Exact wording requires isolated source-fidelity/readability review and coordination with the one-country monitoring queue before a public PR.
